descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S10 Editing the note never re-runs billing or loses the edit: a seeded note edited and reloaded, an edit started while billing is still 'Analyzing note…', and a double tap on Generate (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Billing runs once at Generate and does not re-run when the note is edited (step 5). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Leg seeded: both fixtures seeded with a generated note and a stored billing suggestion for that note. Legs inflight-* and double-tap: fixtures with nothing generated, badge Follow-up

When seeded: Post-Round -> Edit Note -> append a sentence that would raise the level -> Save Edits -> reload. inflight-h / inflight-n: Generate -> Post-Round -> tap Edit Note while the card says 'Analyzing note…' -> type a marker sentence -> wait for the billing card -> Save Edits -> reload. …

Then The billing card text is exactly the seeded one at every seeded checkpoint; the in-flight marker sentence is still in the note after reload and the card shows one code for the generated note; every leg has exactly one billing call per generated note and none after an edit

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): seeded: every checkpoint mustContain the seeded code (99231 / 99308, which appears only on the billing card) and mustNotContain the other codes of the family and 'Analyzing note'; the runner checks the card text equals the seeded billingSuggestion. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
